hodd-01-c1.text: Sarah Kuta (2026). The mysterious dancing plague that killed people in 1518. Popular Science.
hodd-01-c1.quote: The dancing plague began on July 14, 1518, when a woman named Frau Troffea started dancing in Strasbourg, then part of the Holy Roman Empire and now a city in northeastern France.
hodd-01-c1.claim: In July 1518 a woman recorded as Frau Troffea began dancing in a street in Strasbourg, then a free city of the Holy Roman Empire, and kept going for days.
